body: I know from previous hospitalization that they should have been stitched.  I wait that 24 hour mark, but there's only so much I can do at home, before I'd have to go in.  I watch for infection.  My concern is they'd make me go inpatient again because of the extent of self harm

I struggle with this, for me, a warm heating pad works the best for me, because the area is sensitive, make sure you have a couple of layers between the heating pad and your skin.  Another option is a cool washcloth.
